description: Saves a person to put into generate by character_id, so their face holds from picture to picture and in video. Give a clean close-up of the face and, separately, a full-length photo — never a front/side/back sheet, which reads as several people. notes (outfit and details) open every prompt with this person. Kept until deleted.

body_image.description: A separate full-length photo: a public https link, an upload_media link, or an upload id.

extra_images.description: Up to 3 more photos of the same person.

face_image.description: A clean close-up of the face: a public https link, an upload_media link, or an upload id.

name.description: What to call them; the prompt names them by it.

notes.description: Outfit and details, for example: black leather jacket, silver ring on the left hand.

name: create_character
title: Create character
